cim: Mag – art direction, 3. kör: kopár bolygók (kavics, moha, páfrány)
bevezeto: A festett fű után a kavicsos, mohás és páfrányos bolygók csupasznak, gyűrött műanyagnak hatnak (főleg a tüskés csúcsú domborzaton). Bal szélen a játék mostani képe, mellette Pro-val: A – saját festett jelleg minden felszíntakarónak, második színnel és puhább formákkal (két változat); B – szándékosan kopár, de megformált táj. A színek (a bolygó és a fák alapszíne) maradnak.
stilus: Overall art direction for the game: soft, stylized, painterly but clean – Studio Ghibli background painting feel (the principle, not the exact look). Calm and dreamy. Plants keep their own distinct colours (each plant is unique, grown from its DNA). Not cute, not chibi, no faces, no text.

iranyok.prompt: Direction: give this planet's ground cover its own painted identity instead of looking bare. GRAVEL: a sandy painted base with scattered rounded pebbles and a few larger soft stones, small tufts of grass growing in the hollows. MOSS: a velvety, cushiony surface of rounded moss pillows with soft highlights. FERNS: soft painted fern fronds in clumps. Add a SECOND COLOUR: lighter, warmer ridges and peaks, valleys leaning towards the atmosphere colour, and tiny specks of flower colour taken from the trees' own colours scattered in the cover. FORMS: round off the terrain – soft, sculpted hills and rounded peaks, no faceted low-poly triangles, no crumpled-plastic look. COLOUR LOCK: the base hue of the ground and every plant's colours stay as in Image 1 (they come from DNA) – only value, a second related tone and lighting may change. Keep exactly the same plants and composition, no new trees.
